'''CZ-2X Infiltrator Droids''' were [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] created by [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Arms]] during the era of the [[Galactic War]]. Smaller than their sister-models, the Infiltrator droids were utilized to augment the capabiliites of [[CZ-8X Eradicator Droid|CZ-8X]], an Eradicator droid guarding the [[Atrium (CZ-198)|Atrium]] during the conflict brought on by seizure of Czerka's assets by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Department of Adjudication|Adjucators]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].
